answer: Audits are logged in cedar, queued in pulse, and ripple publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 23 identities per epoch. A farm of 340 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3271 identities would post 1888 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
